name: Diabolus ~Kikoku~
source:
A spirit who takes the form of an attractive male is attacking many female students at a school. Two students discover that the only way to free him from his wander arround Earth is to have him fullfill his desire and so they decide to take hands on and make him rest in peace at last. 

[From [url=https://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/anime.php?id=11334]AnimeNewsNetwork[/url]]
translation:
一个化身为迷人男性的幽灵正在攻击学校里的许多女学生。两名学生发现，让他摆脱在地球上徘徊的唯一方法就是让他实现自己的愿望，因此他们决定亲自动手，让他最终安息。
